description: Set a product's pictures: the cover (coverId), the gallery after it (galleryIds, in order; max 12 pictures with the cover) and, optionally, each variant's own pictures. Pictures are operational — like stock, they apply at once on every product, rikma or personal, with no proposal: they show the same product, they do not change what anyone agreed to. Ids come from getUploadSession, uploadMediaFromUrl or getRikmaProduct. Omit galleryIds to keep the gallery and only change the cover. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#setProductImagesTool

coverId.description: Upload id of the cover picture.

galleryIds.description: Upload ids after the cover, in order. [] clears the gallery but the cover.

projectId.description: Rikma (project) id, from findUserProjectsTool. You must be a member.

name: setProductImagesTool
